body: Forward test of the management-tone-vs-delivery method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Medicare Advantage cost trend and rate-hike macro add caution. Resolution: YES if the 2027 adjusted EPS outlook first issued (expected with Q4 2026 results, Jan-2027) has a low end or 'at least' floor ≥ $22.50. If issued as a single point, use that point.
